title: Chladni Sandbox
description: A resonance-pattern studio — watch virtual sand migrate into real Chladni figures as you tune the plate's vibration modes.
concept: Drop thousands of sand grains on a simulated vibrating plate and watch them stochastically settle into the nodal lines of a chosen (n,m) resonant mode, exactly like a real Chladni plate experiment. Drag your finger through the sand to disturb it, tap the plate to re-scatter, morph smoothly between named presets, hear the mode's pitch, and export or share your favorite pattern.
features: Live n/m harmonic-mode sliders (1-12 each) with smooth animated morph between modes
8 named resonance presets (Butterfly, Web, Mandala, Snowflake, Star Burst, Grid Weave, Spiral Knot, Cathedral) plus a Randomize button
Tunable sand: grain count (600-6000) and 6 glow-color swatches, draggable pointer disturbance on the plate itself
Optional dual-oscillator tone mapped to the current n/m harmonic ratio (AudioContext created on first gesture)
Save current pattern to a localStorage gallery, PNG export via canvas.toBlob, and shareable btoa/atob URL-hash links

interaction.mouse: drag across the plate to disturb the settled sand
interaction.click: tap preset cards, randomize, or the plate-tap button to trigger a fresh settle
interaction.touch: same as mouse via Pointer Events; controls collapse into a bottom sheet
interaction.keyboard: not required — all controls are slider/button based
